name: Seagrove House

tagline.en: A family-friendly B&B just minutes from Roundstone village, with views of the Twelve Bens.
tagline.ga: B&B atá oiriúnach do theaghlaigh cúpla nóiméad ó shráidbhaile Chloch na Rón, le radharc ar na Beanna Beola.

mapQuery: Seagrove House B&B, Roundstone, Co. Galway

en: Seagrove House is a family-friendly B&B a few minutes from Roundstone village, looking out to the Twelve Bens mountains.
It’s a peaceful base for beaches, hill walks and drives through Connemara, with the village harbour, cafés and pubs close by.
ga: Is B&B é Seagrove House atá oiriúnach do theaghlaigh, cúpla nóiméad ó shráidbhaile Chloch na Rón, ag féachaint amach ar na Beanna Beola.
Is áit shuaimhneach í le haghaidh tránna, siúlóidí sléibhe agus tiomáint trí Chonamara, agus tá cuan, caiféanna agus tithe tábhairne an tsráidbhaile in aice láimhe.
